name: Greater Strike Joint (Combat)
body:
You are skilled at damaging your opponent’s joints.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, Improved Strike Joint, base attack bonus +9, Int 13.

Benefit(s): You receive a +2 bonus to your Combat Maneuver Bonus when performing this combat maneuver against a foe. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by Improved Strike Joint. In addition, you add a +2 to the DC of the saving throw against the effects of this maneuver.
